body:
Sorry for the delayed reply and also not tackling this myself (maintaining my own OSS stuff around Ember.js eats most of my OSS time)

The change at https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/commit/409295cc80c90a29141c101c90e45bdd24817514 is what we needed.

> I mean what's the underlying need to not just use the facets min max computation?

On an empty query, the min/max values for each facet don't (currently) represent the whole index, so you get values that only represent the 1000 most popular values for each facet. @speedblue explained why in an email and suggested allowing user override would be a good short-term solution.
